BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 1,023,195 of its own ordinary shares between July 13 and July 17, 2026, with prices ranging from 68.00 pence to 71.70 pence per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled. Following these transactions, the company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 344,443,667 ordinary shares, with 3,867,640 held in treasury, leaving 340,576,027 shares for shareholder notification calculations. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 20 July 2026 20 July 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 13 July 2026 14 July 2026 15 July 2026 16 July 2026 17 July 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 285,285 127,388 285,461 200,903 133,559 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 69.10 69.00 70.30 71.10 71.70 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 68.30 68.00 68.50 69.80 70.70 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 68.8466 68.6673 69.6504 70.7058 71.3742 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 344,443,667 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 340,576,027 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
